question: The marked price of a book is Rs. 250 and it was sold at a discount of 12%. The selling price of the book is:
solution:
Given:

The marked price of a book is Rs. 250

And gave a discount of 12%.

Formula:

S.P = M.P × (100 - D%)/100

Where,

S.P = Selling price

M.P = Marked price

D = Discount%

Calculation:

S.P = M.P × (100 - D%)/100

⇒ 250 × (100 - 12)/100

⇒ 250 × 0.88 = 220

∴ The selling price of a book is Rs. 220
